{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is 'money well spent' but wants more weather features.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Money well spent, just want a little more weather stuff."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing requests for weather effects like snowstorms, dust storms, and lightning damage.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "snowstorm in any of the icy cold biomes, or a dust devil in the desert area, and it could give the players around it a drought effect and it could make the players weakened and dizzy."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing requests for loot drops from rainbows, including gold, diamonds, and extra ores.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "find a chest or cauldron with gold and diamonds! It can last for 2 min, 8 min, 10 min, 15 min, and 20 min. You’ll also do a little more damage and the mobs and players you hit will get a highlighted border."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing requests for new environmental hazards like heatwaves causing damage over time.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "if you don’t get out of the heatwave (75-150 blocks), then you’ll take half a heart every 1.37 seconds."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing requests for new mobs like blueberry cows and quicksand traps.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "there should be a mob called the blueberry cow... There could also be quick sand for some traps and a sinkhole for some desert updates."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing requests for new weather effects like dust storms causing blindness and slowness.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "dust storm that can make you blind with dust and make you slow."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing requests for new lighting effects like atmospheric lighting and red lighting.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "atmospheric lighting or instead of lighting striking down, it can spread out and hit different objects."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing requests for new status effects like 'lucky potion' from rainbow interactions.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "if you suck up a part of the rainbow then you’ll get a lucky potion that you can drink to get the lucky effect and if you drink it, then you’ll get one extra ore of any kind, even netherite!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing requests for new environmental mechanics like quicksand requiring silk touch tools.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "There could also be quick sand for some traps and a sinkhole for some desert updates. In order to get quicksand, you’ll need a silk touch tool, like an axe, shovel, (ideal), or a pickaxe."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing requests for new weather events like hurricanes dragging players into oceans.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "the hurricanes can drag the players into the ocean floors and you can only escape with ender pearls or you can clutch."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing requests for new mobs like tornados causing dizziness and waterspouts launching players.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The tornados can make you dizzy and the waterspouts can launch the players into the sky."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing requests for new environmental effects like sun dogs and atmospheric halos.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "some optical phenomena, like sun dogs, atmospheric halos, and iredescence."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",

    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
